description: Feature 3.6 cache mutation safety — contract defined; live execution BLOCKED

test_case.scenario: Caller A receives cached data, performs local filtering/mutation. Caller B must still receive correct source-derived data.

current_design_evidence.dashboard_page: load_yearly_features returns fresh dicts; page reads only. No in-place mutation of cached structure.
current_design_evidence.model_object: shared read-only inference resource; predict_popularity does not mutate the pipeline
